coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: Channel Street (open space)

milestones.text: Port Commission approves the Mission Rock Design Controls, which define the planned Channel Street open space (Design Controls Section 3.7); the Port's Jan 26, 2018 staff report requested this approval under Resolution 18-04, and its Sept 2019 memo dates the Commission's approvals January 30, 2018 (it numbers the Design Controls resolution 18-05)

changes.text: The notes and the changelog row said the 2019 Phase 1 submittal delivered an interim plaza here, that the permanent design comes with Block C, and that satellite imagery shows paving and planting today. The 2019 submittal is only a plan and does not say which lot any interim plaza is; nothing read ties Channel Street to Block C; and no imagery source was cited. Those claims are removed and the notes say the lot's current condition is not confirmed; status stays planned. The June 2026 Phase 2 milestone that named Channel Street and Block C was removed from this record because the Port memo never mentions either. The Jan 30, 2018 Design Controls approval milestone no longer calls the space an interim plaza and now cites the Sept 2019 Port memo that states the date.

Channel Street added on its real lot: the planned open space between Blocks B and C. The 2019 Phase 1 submittal planned interim treatments for Channel Street; what was built on the lot is not confirmed. (An earlier version of this row said it was an interim plaza today, which no source supports.)
changes.source: Mission Rock Design Controls, Section 3.7; 2019 Phase 1 submittal; DataSF Parcels; Port Commission Item 7A memo, Sept 20 2019 (January 30, 2018 approval)

record.notes: Channel Street (open space) -- the Design Controls' Section 3.7 open space between Blocks B and C, from 3rd Street to the Shared Public Way: a 50 ft plaza with a 12 ft pedestrian throughway, a tree grove and active edges along both blocks. Its own real Assessor lot, 8719C004 (1,110 m2, recorded 2020-06-12 with the Seawall Lot 337 subdivision), matching Figure 3.1.1's Channel Street rectangle. Recorded as 'planned' rather than 'complete': the 2019 Phase 1 submittal listed 'Two interim pedestrian plazas south of Parcels B and F' among Phase 1's public spaces and said several streets 'will be given interim treatments (Bridgeview Street and Channel Street)'. That is a plan: it does not say either plaza is this lot, and no source read says what was built here or when. No source read ties the permanent Channel Street design to a block or phase. Current condition of the lot not confirmed (no imagery source cited). Added 2026-09-17 (Mission Rock geometry brief).
